title: Moesha
description:
S1 E1 — Pilot
Moesha clashes with her new stepmother.  When she ignores Dee’s grounding and goes to the local hangout, the Den, her heart is broken when she finds Ohagi, the boy she likes, with another girl.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E2 — Friends
The meaning of Moesha’s and Kim’s friendship is tested when they both try out for the cheerleading team -- and Kim gets picked, and Moesha doesn’t.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E3 — Sixteen
Moesha is now officially allowed to date because she is turning sixteen, although Frank remains extremely reluctant.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E4 — Hakeem Owes Moesha Big
Moesha and her father coach Hakeem on how to get a job.  As a result, the owner of a sporting goods store (Bo Jackson) hires him.

S2 E22 — The Audit
Guest stars Red Buttons and Ron Glass appear in this unique 'Special Episode' of '227' which was videotaped only 24 hours prior to airing, enabling the characters to discuss late-breaking news items.

S3 E1 — My Aching Back
Mary and Sandra vie for a chance to deliver a line in a movie being shot at their building.

S3 E2 — The Talk Show
Sandra's show-biz career as a talk-show host threatens the friendship of the whole group when she questions them on the air about sex in the eighties.

S3 E3 — There Goes The Building
Rose receives an offer to buy her building from a real estate magnate whose plan to renovate means tearing down 227.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E21 — Retreat & Surrender
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E22 — Jingle Fever
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E1 — Been There, Done That
Malcolm's good luck streak is matched bad Eddie's sudden run of bad fortune.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E2 — Roofless People
To fix a leaky roof, the bank loan officer forces Malcolm to hire his daughter.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E3 — Casino Evil
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.
